name: 飞书 / Lark
author: r1n7aro
summary: Feishu / Lark for Locus scripts: sign in on the plugin's settings page, then read and write wiki pages, documents, sheets, bases, drive files, chats and messages through locus.lark in Python.

summaryI18n.en: Feishu / Lark for Locus scripts: sign in on the plugin's settings page, then read and write wiki pages, documents, sheets, bases, drive files, chats and messages through locus.lark in Python.
summaryI18n.zh: 在 Locus 脚本中读写飞书 / Lark：在插件设置页登录后，通过 Python 的 locus.lark 访问知识库、云文档、电子表格、多维表格、云空间、群聊和消息。

description: Adds locus.lark to the Locus Python SDK, an object-oriented async client for the Feishu / Lark Open Platform. It covers wiki spaces and pages; documents (Markdown read and write, block edits, images and files, version history); drive files with upload, download, import and export; comments, collaborators and link sharing; sheets; bases; and chats and messages (send, reply, recall, forward, reactions, pins, announcements, urgent notifications, members, create and disband chats). lark.api calls any other endpoint. Sign in on the plugin's Settings tab: create a personal app in your tenant in one step or enter an existing one, then confirm in Feishu. The app secret and refresh token stay in the system keychain; scripts get short-lived tokens and call the Open Platform directly. Nothing loads until used: one lazy tool, a one-line Skill summary, and httpx installed on first use. Needs Locus 0.9.4 or later.

descriptionI18n.zh: 为 Locus Python SDK 增加 locus.lark：面向对象的飞书 / Lark 开放平台异步客户端。覆盖知识库空间与页面；云文档（Markdown 读写、块级编辑、插图和附件、历史版本）；云空间文件的上传、下载、导入和导出；评论、协作者与链接分享；电子表格；多维表格；群聊与消息（发送、回复、撤回、转发、表情回复、Pin、群公告、加急、成员管理、建群和解散群）。其他接口可用 lark.api 直接调用。在插件设置页登录：一键在租户中创建个人应用或填写已有应用，然后在飞书中确认。App Secret 和 refresh token 保存在系统钥匙串，脚本只拿到短期 token 并直接访问开放平台。安装后没有常驻开销：唯一的工具按需加载，Skill 只占一行摘要，httpx 首次使用时才安装。需要 Locus 0.9.4 或更高版本。
